Container.Name: Roampage
Container.Overview:
A self-hosted, responsive dashboard for your services. Fully configurable from the browser — no code editing needed.
Features: - Responsive UI (desktop and mobile) - Inline editing — add, reorder and edit services directly from the browser - Multi-page support with custom wallpapers - Live health checks for each service - 2500+ icons via dashboardicons.com - Widgets: Clock, Weather, Bookmarks, Text, Image, Iframe, Countdown, System monitor - Encrypted config and backups (AES-256-GCM) - Import / Export your full config as JSON
Designed for trusted local networks. No built-in authentication — use a reverse proxy (Authelia, Authentik, nginx basic auth) if exposing outside your LAN.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Roampage web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for config, backups and wallpapers.

Config.Name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: AES-256-GCM key for config and backups. Leave empty for auto-generated key (saved to /data/.roampage.key). Set to 'none' to disable encryption. For portability across rebuilds, provide a fixed 64-char hex key: openssl rand -hex 32
